I changed `src/solution.py` to apply the Friday rule as written. I haven't run it or written any checks.

- **Friday rule:** The old code cut Friday's working day to end at 15:00. That wrongly excluded a 15:00 start and shortened the meeting end time as well. Now the working day still ends at 17:00 on Fridays. A separate latest-start limit of 15:00 applies, so a 15:00 start is allowed and later starts are excluded. Meetings must still end by 17:00.
- **Minimum duration check:** I removed the "duration must be at least 15" error, because the requirements don't ask for it. Durations of zero or less still raise an error.
- **Event clamping:** I removed the code that trimmed events to working hours before checking conflicts. It wasn't needed, and the results are the same either way.

Everything else is unchanged: 09:00–17:00 hours, the 12:00–13:00 lunch block, 15-minute slots, and back-to-back meetings allowed. Results don't depend on the order of the events.
